$comment: Freshness policy for scripts/check_freshness.py and scripts/check_claims.py. Validated by check_freshness.validate_policy (run: python scripts/check_freshness.py --validate-policy). Every override needs a reason; the day counts are maintainer policy choices, not measured API-churn rates. See docs/FRESHNESS.md.

foundations.reason: Math/statistics/Python-idiom content; the concepts do not change between library releases.

classical-ml.reason: scikit-learn-centred; its deprecation cycle spans two minor releases, so a yearly-ish review is usually enough.

llm.reason: Vendor SDKs, model identifiers and fine-tuning libraries (peft/trl/transformers) change quickly.

security.reason: Threat guidance and the standards it cites (e.g. OWASP lists) are revised on short cycles.

mlops.reason: Serving/tracking/orchestration tools (MLflow, FastAPI, Airflow, ONNX export) ship breaking changes often.

mcp-tool-integration.reason: The MCP specification is versioned by date and has been revised more than once a year; policy choice.

model-optimization.reason: Its Workflow relies on the torch.export-based ONNX exporter (dynamo=True), which is still moving between torch releases; see its version_constraints.

ignore_imports.src: Placeholder for the user's own project package in ci-cd-for-ml examples; not a PyPI distribution.

known_stale_patterns.message: sklearn.cross_validation is gone (not importable in current scikit-learn; superseded by sklearn.model_selection since 0.18); use sklearn.model_selection
sklearn.preprocessing.Imputer is gone (sklearn.impute.SimpleImputer adopted it in scikit-learn 0.20); use sklearn.impute.SimpleImputer
sklearn.externals.joblib is gone; import joblib directly
openai.Completion.create is the pre-1.0 openai-python API; v1+ uses client.chat.completions.create
openai.ChatCompletion.create is the pre-1.0 openai-python API; v1+ uses client.chat.completions.create
text-davinci-* completion models are retired; verify current model availability against vendor docs
